comments.content: The declarations here don't match the definitions in DrawViewPart.cpp. The .cpp defines these as non-static member functions taking only `std::string element` (e.g. `bool DrawViewPart::isCosmeticVertex(std::string element)`), but the header declares them as `static` functions taking `App::DocumentObject* owner, std::string element`. This mismatch will cause a compile/link error. Update the header declarations to `bool isCosmeticVertex(std::string element);` etc. (non-static, single parameter) to match the implementation.
